intro_en: You will learn to talk about your free time and hobbies like reading, cooking, walking, drawing and watching movies. You will also learn how to say what you like to do with -х дуртай in Mongolian and like + -ing in English.
intro_mn: Та энэ хичээлээр чөлөөт цаг болон хоббиныхоо (унших, хоол хийх, алхах, зурах, кино үзэх) тухай ярьж сурна. Мөн монгол хэлний -х дуртай болон англи хэлний like + -ing бүтцийг ашиглаж сурна.

vocab.example_en: I don't have much free time.
I like reading books in the evening.
We like walking in the park.

vocab.example_mn: Бид амралтын өдөр кино үзэх дуртай.
vocab.example_en: We like watching movies on weekends.
I like singing with my friends.

sentences.en: What do you like to do?

alt_en: Do you like to watch movies?
Yes, I like to watch movies.
No, I don't like to sing.

sentences.en: In my free time I read books.
alt_en: I read books in my free time.
He likes to listen to music.

grammar.title_en: Saying what you like: verb + -х дуртай
grammar.title_mn: Дуртай зүйлээ хэлэх: үйл үг + -х дуртай
grammar.explain_en: In Mongolian, take the verb stem and add -х (-ах, -эх, -ох, -өх by vowel harmony, or -их after ш, ж, ч) to make the 'to do' form, then add дуртай: унших дуртай = like reading, алхах дуртай = like walking. The subject comes first: Би унших дуртай. For 'don't like', use дургүй: Би дуулах дургүй. For yes/no questions, add юу: Та зурах дуртай юу? Phrases like хоол хийх and кино үзэх keep their object before the verb.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд "like" гэсний дараа үйл үгийг -ing хэлбэрээр хэлнэ: I like reading, She likes cooking. "To" хэлбэр ч болно: I like to read. Үгүйсгэхдээ don't/doesn't like гэнэ: I don't like singing. Асуухдаа Do you like...? гэнэ. Тэр (he/she) гэх мэт 3-р биед likes (s-тэй) гэж бичихийг анхаараарай: He likes drawing.

fill_blank.explain_en: After the -х verb form we use дуртай to say 'like'.
fill_blank.explain_mn: -х үйл үгийн дараа "дуртай" гэж хэлж дуртайгаа илэрхийлнэ.

fill_blank.explain_en: Зур- has the vowel у, so we use -ах: зурах.
fill_blank.explain_mn: "Зур" гэдэг үгэнд у эгшиг байгаа тул -ах нэмж "зурах" болно.

fill_blank.explain_en: Yes/no questions end with юу. вэ is used with question words like юу, хэн.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Тийм/үгүй гэж хариулах асуултад "юу" ашиглана. "Вэ" асуух үгтэй хамт орно.

fill_blank.explain_en: After 'like' we use the -ing form (or 'to read').
With he/she/it, the verb takes -s: likes.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Тэр (he/she/it)-ийн хувьд үйл үг -s авна: likes.

fill_blank.explain_en: With I, the negative is don't + like.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Сайн уу, Тим! Чи чөлөөт цагаараа юу хийх дуртай вэ?
dialogue.en: Hi, Tim! What do you like to do in your free time?
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain uu, Tim! Chi chölööt tsagaaraa yuu khiikh durtai ve?

dialogue.speaker: Tim
dialogue.mn: Сайн уу, Сараа. Би хоол хийх, алхах дуртай.
dialogue.en: Hi, Saraa. I like cooking and walking.
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain uu, Saraa. Bi khool khiikh, alkhakh durtai.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Сайхан байна! Би хоол хийх дургүй, гэхдээ зурах дуртай.
dialogue.en: Nice! I don't like cooking, but I like drawing.
dialogue.mn_latin: Saikhan baina! Bi khool khiikh durgüi, gekhdee zurakh durtai.

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Тийм, амралтын өдөр найзуудтайгаа кино үзэх дуртай.
dialogue.en: Yes, I like watching movies with my friends on weekends.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim, amraltyn ödör naizuudtaigaa kino üzekh durtai.

dialogue.speaker: Tim
dialogue.mn: Би ч гэсэн! Ном унших дуртай юу?
dialogue.en: Me too! Do you like reading?
dialogue.mn_latin: Bi ch gesen! Nom unshikh durtai yuu?

dialogue.speaker: Сараа
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ, орой ном унших дуртай.
dialogue.en: Yes, I like reading books in the evening.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee, oroi nom unshikh durtai.

culture_note.en: Many people in Ulaanbaatar spend weekends walking in places like Zaisan or Sukhbaatar Square, or going out of the city to the countryside. Reading and chess are also popular, and many families enjoy cooking buuz together before holidays like Tsagaan Sar.
culture_note.mn: Улаанбаатарын олон хүн амралтын өдөр Зайсан, Сүхбаатарын талбай зэрэг газраар алхах, хөдөө гарах дуртай. Ном унших, шатар тоглох нь бас түгээмэл бөгөөд олон айл Цагаан сар зэрэг баярын өмнө хамт бууз хийх дуртай.

review.notes: Mostly good; there are a few small errors (nonsense 'ширээ' in the explanation, a duplicated alt, and an odd distractor).

opus_fix.notes: Fixed unnatural Mongolian phrasing, a fill-blank option that was also correct, the missing -их ending, and the en/mn culture note mismatch.

changes.why: The phrase 'хобби (...)-гоо ярьж' is awkward and needs 'тухай'.
'цөөн' is for countable nouns. Time takes 'бага', and the sentence should match the English.
'Миний чөлөөт цагаар би' is an unnatural calque.
The alt_mn list is updated after the main sentence changed.
The ending in унших is -их (унш + их), which was missing from the list.
'Би ч гэсэн' is the natural way to say 'me too'.
The Mongolian now matches 'many people' and 'holidays like Tsagaan Sar'.
